# Costs

<!-- Generated by `rake docs` from the primitive registry. Do not edit. -->

## behold

Behold `count` (default 1) objects matching the card spec `card`: each a card revealed from your hand or a permanent you control, chosen while casting or activating. `exile: true` also exiles them as it becomes cast; they are then "exiled with" it (selector `exiled_with`).

Rules: CR 701.4a, CR 701.4b, CR 601.2h, CR 602.2b, CR 118.3, CR 607.2a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `card` | card spec (required), e.g. {"subtypes": ["goblin"]} |
| `count` | integer (default 1) |
| `exile` | true: exile what was beheld |

```json
{
  "behold": {
    "card": {
      "subtypes": [
        "goblin"
      ]
    },
    "exile": true
  }
}
```

## blight

Blight `amount`: put that many -1/-1 counters on a creature you control, chosen while casting or activating and put on it as it becomes cast.

Rules: CR 701.68a, CR 701.68b, CR 601.2h, CR 602.2b, CR 118.3

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `amount` | integer >= 1 |

```json
{
  "blight": {
    "amount": 1
  }
}
```

## bottom_self_from_graveyard

Put this card from your graveyard on the bottom of your library. An ability with this cost is activated from your graveyard.

Rules: CR 401.1, CR 113.6m, CR 602.2b, CR 118.3

```json
"bottom_self_from_graveyard"
```

## discard

Discard `count` cards (default 1) from your hand, never this card, matching the card spec `card` if given: chosen while casting or activating and discarded as the spell or ability becomes cast. `random: true` discards them at random instead.

Rules: CR 701.9a, CR 701.9b, CR 601.2h, CR 602.2b, CR 118.3

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `count` | integer (default 1) |
| `card` | card spec, e.g. {"types": ["land"]} |
| `random` | true: at random (CR 701.9b) |

```json
{
  "discard": {
    "count": 1
  }
}
```

## discard_self

Discard the card the ability belongs to (it goes from your hand to your graveyard). An ability with this cost is activated from your hand.

Rules: CR 701.9a, CR 602.2b, CR 113.6m, CR 118.3

```json
"discard_self"
```

## exert

Exert this permanent: it doesn't untap during your next untap step.

Rules: CR 701.43a, CR 701.43b, CR 701.43c

```json
"exert"
```

## exile_from_graveyard

Exile `count` cards from your graveyard (default 1), never this card, chosen while casting or activating and exiled as the spell or ability becomes cast. `card` (a card spec) restricts which.

Rules: CR 406.1, CR 601.2h, CR 602.2b, CR 118.3

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `count` | integer (default 1) |
| `card` | card spec, e.g. {"types": ["creature"]} |

```json
{
  "exile_from_graveyard": {
    "count": 2
  }
}
```

## exile_from_hand

Exile `count` cards from your hand (default 1), chosen while casting or activating, exiled as the spell or ability becomes cast. `card` (a card spec) restricts which.

Rules: CR 406.1, CR 601.2h, CR 602.2b, CR 118.3

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `count` | integer (default 1) |
| `card` | card spec, e.g. {"types": ["creature"]} |

```json
{
  "exile_from_hand": {
    "count": 1
  }
}
```

## exile_self_from_graveyard

Exile this card from your graveyard. An ability with this cost is activated from your graveyard.

Rules: CR 406.1, CR 113.6m, CR 602.2b, CR 118.3

```json
"exile_self_from_graveyard"
```

## get_counters

You get `amount` counters of the kind `counter` (e.g. poison). It can always be paid.

Rules: CR 118.1, CR 122.1, CR 704.5c

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `counter` | player counter kind, e.g. "poison" |
| `amount` | integer >= 1 |

```json
{
  "get_counters": {
    "counter": "poison",
    "amount": 5
  }
}
```

## mana

Pay mana as part of an activation. Paid during the activation by spending mana from your pool, tapping sources one at a time.

Rules: CR 601.2g, CR 601.2h, CR 602.2b

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `(value)` | mana cost string, e.g. "{1}{R}" |

```json
{
  "mana": "{1}{R}"
}
```

## one_of

Pay one of the listed costs (two or more), chosen as the spell or ability is cast or activated (the `choose_cost_option` decision) or, for `pay` and ward, as it is paid. A cost that can't be paid can't be chosen.

Rules: CR 118.3, CR 601.2b, CR 601.2f, CR 602.2b, CR 118.12

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `(list)` | two or more costs |

```json
{
  "one_of": [
    {
      "behold": {
        "card": {
          "subtypes": [
            "goblin"
          ]
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "mana": "{2}"
    }
  ]
}
```

## pay_life

Pay that much life (you lose it). Only possible while your life total is at least that much. `"X"` pays the X announced for the spell or ability (at most your life total); it may be a spell's additional cost.

Rules: CR 119.4, CR 119.4b, CR 118.3b, CR 601.2b, CR 107.3a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `(value)` | integer >= 1, or "X" |

```json
{
  "pay_life": 2
}
```

## remove_counters

Remove `count` counters (of kind `counter`, or any kind) from among permanents you control matching `filter` (default creature), one counter per choice. Removed as it becomes cast.

Rules: CR 602.2b, CR 601.2h, CR 118.3, CR 122.1

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `count` | integer |
| `filter` | filter (default creature) |
| `counter` | counter name (optional) |

```json
{
  "remove_counters": {
    "count": 3
  }
}
```

## sacrifice

Sacrifice the permanent the ability belongs to (it goes to its owner's graveyard).

Rules: CR 701.21a, CR 602.2b, CR 118.3

```json
"sacrifice"
```

## sacrifice_permanent

Sacrifice `count` permanents you control matching `filter` (`other: true`: not the source). Chosen while casting or activating, sacrificed as it becomes cast; the sacrificed permanent's last known types and subtypes are remembered (condition `sacrificed`).

Rules: CR 701.21a, CR 601.2h, CR 602.2b, CR 118.3, CR 608.2h

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `filter` | filter (default permanent) |
| `count` | integer (default 1) |
| `other` | true: not the source itself |

```json
{
  "sacrifice_permanent": {
    "filter": "creature",
    "other": true
  }
}
```

## tap

{T} — tap the permanent the ability belongs to. Requires it to be untapped.

Rules: CR 107.5, CR 602.5a

```json
"tap"
```

## tap_another_creature

Tap another untapped creature you control, chosen while activating. A creature that came under your control this turn can be tapped this way.

Rules: CR 702.184a, CR 601.2h, CR 602.2b, CR 302.6

```json
"tap_another_creature"
```

## tap_permanents

Tap `count` untapped permanents you control matching `filter` (default: creature), chosen while casting or activating; `other: true` excludes the source. They are tapped as they are chosen; cancelling untaps them.

Rules: CR 601.2h, CR 602.2b, CR 302.6, CR 118.3

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `count` | integer (default 1) |
| `filter` | filter (default creature) |
| `other` | true: not the source itself |

```json
{
  "tap_permanents": {
    "count": 3,
    "filter": {
      "creature": {
        "types": [
          "artifact"
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## waterbend

Waterbend [cost]: pay this mana cost; for each generic mana in it you may instead tap an untapped artifact or creature you control (pay_cost option `{type: "waterbend", object: id}`). Only the waterbend cost's own generic mana can be paid this way.

Rules: CR 701.67a, CR 701.67b, CR 701.67c

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `(value)` | mana cost string, e.g. "{3}" or "{X}" |

```json
{
  "waterbend": "{3}"
}
```
